entries.title: Persuasion: Anne Meets Captain Benwick
entries.hook: At a Lyme evening, Anne is placed beside a young captain deep in mourning. What can she possibly say?

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: At the Harvilles' small house, Captains Wentworth and Harville talked of former days, while Anne found herself placed apart with Captain Benwick.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: Benwick was young, engaged once, and left grieving; he filled his days with poetry and grief.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: Anne, remembering her own losses, began the acquaintance with care. Tomorrow, listen to what she recommends to a heart in mourning.

entries.answer: Captain Benwick, a grieving young officer.
entries.visualBrief: Quiet Regency seaside parlour at evening with an adult woman and a solemn young naval officer seated apart from the group near a window, candlelight, restrained melancholy, hands out of frame, no readable text.

entries.title: Hotel Check-In: Confirm the Name
entries.hook: A hotel check-in has three catches: the name, the room, and the payment.

turns.speaker: receptionist
turns.text: Good evening. May I have the name on the booking?

turns.speaker: guest
turns.text: Helen Brooks, two nights, twin room.

turns.speaker: receptionist
turns.text: Thank you. Room two fourteen, breakfast from seven. Please sign here.

entries.visualBrief: Bright modern hotel reception with an adult traveller and an adult receptionist at a wooden desk, upper bodies only, hands below frame, warm amber and cream palette, no readable text.

entries.title: Persuasion: The Walk to the Cobb
entries.hook: The Uppercross party descends to the sea. What is their object?

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: The party passed the deserted sea-shore rooms and descended to the water's edge.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: They proceeded towards the Cobb, equally its object in itself and on Captain Wentworth's account.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: For near the old pier, in a small house, the Harvilles were settled.

entries.prompt: Why do they walk to the Cobb?
entries.answer: For the Cobb itself and to visit the Harvilles.
entries.visualBrief: Autumn English seaside with an old stone pier and a small group of elegantly dressed adult figures walking along the empty shore, wide restrained composition, hands out of frame, no readable text.

entries.title: Hotel English: Breakfast and Checkout
entries.hook: Breakfast starts at seven. But what time does your checkout start?

turns.speaker: guest
turns.text: What time is breakfast, and when is checkout?

turns.speaker: receptionist
turns.text: Breakfast runs from seven to ten. Checkout is any time before eleven.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: Two times, two answers. Listen for from and before: one is a range, one is a limit.

entries.visualBrief: Bright anime hotel breakfast room in the morning with an adult guest asking an adult staff member near a set table, chest-up framing, hands below frame, cream blue and honey palette, no readable text.
